added.summary: Every entity inside a sensor now, each once, in entity order: who stands on a pressure plate, what lies in a pickup zone. It reads og.Contact, the pairs of the last step, so it is what og.SensorEntered and og.SensorExited have added up to and stays right through a restore and a hit stop; a system that calls it lists og.Contact in its reads. Refused for an entity without an og.Collider; a solid holds nothing.
